## What we use

Receiver (MAX2851) and transmitter (MAX2850) electrical characteristics for
SPEC-001 and G05, and the MAX2871's reference, PFD, VCO and noise figures as
the candidate translator LO for SPEC-007. Restated with page references in
`vendor/summary/analog-devices-max2851.md`, `analog-devices-max2850.md` and
`analog-devices-max2871.md`. No figure, table or text is reproduced.
